events.text: Airline founded in Medellín by a group of 13 Colombian entrepreneurs
Airline began commercial service with Saunders ST-27 aircraft

evidence.quote: The airline began service in 1972 with Saunders ST-27 aircraft for

evidence.quote: By 1976 , the airline had expanded its network to smaller regional destinations
In 1981 , it acquired its first Boeing 727-100

events.text: Fleet expansion with more 727-100 and Fairchild FH-227 aircraft

events.text: Expanded routes to Fort Lauderdale, Quito, Caracas, Caribbean and Puerto Rico destinations
